# Wire C++ auto-generated __ffi_init__ to Python __init__ with reflection-driven signatures

## TL;DR
- `_make_init` builds a proper Python `__init__` that delegates to C++ `__ffi_init__`, with an `inspect.Signature` derived from reflection field metadata (`c_init`, `c_kw_only`, `c_has_default` flags).
- Two new field bitmask flags exposed in Cython: `kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskInitOff` (bit 9) and `kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskKwOnly` (bit 10); `TypeField` gains `c_init`, `c_kw_only`, `c_has_default` attributes.
- `core.KWARGS` sentinel object added for the kwargs-pack protocol; 7 new test fixture classes + 895-line test suite cover the full auto-init contract.

## Key Exports

```python
# registry.py — new helpers

def _make_init(type_cls: type, type_info: TypeInfo) -> Callable[..., None]:
    """Build __init__ that delegates to C++ __ffi_init__ via KWARGS protocol."""
    # Interacts with: core.KWARGS, TypeInfo.fields, TypeInfo.methods
    # Invariant: type_cls must have __tvm_ffi_type_info__ set before calling
    # Extension: signature is built by _make_init_signature; override that for custom layout

def _make_init_signature(type_info: TypeInfo) -> inspect.Signature:
    """Build inspect.Signature from reflection field metadata (parent-first order)."""
    # Walks parent chain; collects fields where c_init=True
    # Positional: required first, then with defaults (c_has_default=True)
    # KwOnly: c_kw_only=True fields, same required/default ordering
    # Interacts with: TypeInfo.parent_type_info (chain traversal), TypeField.c_init/c_kw_only/c_has_default

def _install_init(cls: type, *, enabled: bool) -> None:
    """Install __init__ or a TypeError guard on cls."""
    # Skips if __init__ already in cls.__dict__
    # If enabled and __ffi_init__ metadata has auto_init=True: installs _make_init output
    # If enabled and __ffi_init__ exists but auto_init=False: installs __ffi_init__ directly
    # If enabled and no __ffi_init__ and not PyNativeObject: raises TypeError with guidance
    # If not enabled: raises TypeError("cannot be constructed directly")
    # Interacts with: TypeInfo.methods[name=="__ffi_init__"].metadata["auto_init"]

# TypeField (type_info.pxi) — new attributes
class TypeField:
    c_init: bool = True           # False if kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskInitOff set
    c_kw_only: bool = False       # True if kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskKwOnly set
    c_has_default: bool = False   # True if kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskHasDefault set
    # Interacts with: _make_init_signature, field bitmask in C ABI TVMFFIFieldInfo.flags

# core.pyi / core.pyx
KWARGS: Object  # Global sentinel used by auto-generated __init__ to start kwargs packing
# Invariant: KWARGS is a singleton obtained via ffi.GetKwargsObject at module load

# _add_class_attrs change: ordering fixed
# Before: _add_class_attrs called before setattr(__tvm_ffi_type_info__)
# After:  setattr(__tvm_ffi_type_info__) first, then _add_class_attrs
# Invariant: type_info must be on cls before _add_class_attrs so _install_init can read it
```

## Impact
- API: `TypeField` gains 3 new attributes (`c_init`, `c_kw_only`, `c_has_default`) — additive, no breakage. `core.KWARGS` added as module-level object.
- Behavioral: Classes with `auto_init=True` on their `__ffi_init__` method now get a proper `__init__` with positional/kw-only/default argument layout matching C++ reflection. Previously `__init__` was set to `__ffi_init__` directly (no Python-friendly signature). Classes without `__ffi_init__` now raise `TypeError` (with better message including type key and guidance) instead of `RuntimeError("not implemented")`.
- Flags/config: `kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskInitOff` (bit 9), `kTVMFFIFieldFlagBitMaskKwOnly` (bit 10) — new field flag bits in C ABI (`TVMFFIFieldInfo.flags`).
- Data formats/schemas: `__ffi_init__` method metadata now consulted for `auto_init: bool` key.

## Design Elements
Design elements this commit consumes:
- `__ffi_init__` constructor registration pattern (0008-reflection) — reads `TypeInfo.methods` to find `__ffi_init__` and its `metadata["auto_init"]` flag.
- `TypeField` / `TypeInfo` Python reflection objects (0012-python-bindings) — extends `TypeField` dataclass with 3 new fields derived from C ABI `TVMFFIFieldInfo.flags`.
- `TVMFFIFieldInfo.flags` bitmask (0007-c-abi) — adds two new flag bits.
- `_add_class_attrs` / `register_object` pipeline (0012-python-bindings) — refactors init installation out into `_install_init`.

Design elements this commit produces:
- `_make_init` / `_make_init_signature` — new internal helpers in `registry.py` that bridge C++ reflection metadata to Python `inspect.Signature`.
- `_install_init` — extracted and generalized init-installation logic replacing inline `if has_c_init` block.
- `core.KWARGS` sentinel — runtime object used as the kwargs-pack start marker in `__ffi_init__` calls.

## Usage Examples

Auto-init via reflection (cross-layer: C++ ObjectDef → Python constructor):

```python
# C++ side (ObjectDef with refl::init() + field traits):
# ObjectDef<TestCxxAutoInitObj>()
#   .def_field("a", &T::a, refl::init())
#   .def_field("b", &T::b, refl::init(false))
#   .def_field("c", &T::c, refl::init(), refl::KwOnly())
#   .def_field("d", &T::d, refl::HasDefault())
#   .def(refl::init<int, int, int, int>());

# Python auto-generated __init__ (positional required, positional default, kw-only required):
obj = _TestCxxAutoInit(a=1, c=3)        # d has default; b excluded from init
obj = _TestCxxAutoInit(1, c=3)          # positional a, kw-only c
obj = _TestCxxAutoInit(1, 4, c=3)       # positional a, d=4, kw-only c

# Inspect the generated signature:
import inspect
sig = inspect.signature(_TestCxxAutoInit.__init__)
# => (self, a: ..., d: ... = __SENTINEL, *, c: ...)
```
